name: docparse_profile_probe
description: Classify a host-approved local document or parse result into a review-required profile proposal without extracting final fields or table rows.

user_message.description: Original user request or short task note used for profile-probe context.

document_path.description: Workspace-local or host-approved document artifact reference to inspect.

result_path.description: Workspace-local JSON profile-probe or parser result produced by document_parse or a host parser adapter.

parse_result.description: Inline parser or profile-probe result when the caller already has host-produced output.

document_type.description: Caller-provided document type hint; unknown values keep proposal-only routing.

profile_id.description: Optional host profile identifier; when present the host may skip public discovery.

page_limit.description: Maximum number of pages to inspect for profile probing.

page_range.description: Optional 1-based contiguous page range such as 2 or 2-4 when probing part of a bundled document.

profile_probe_only.description: Force classify-only profile probing; do not extract final fields or table rows.

classify_only.description: Alias for profile_probe_only when callers ask only for document type classification.

profile_discovery_search.description: Allow host-owned public discovery search when the host explicitly configured a search provider.

enable_profile_discovery_search.description: Alias for profile_discovery_search used by host playbooks.

disable_profile_discovery_search.description: Disable host-owned public discovery search for this profile probe request.

artifact_policy.description: Artifact retention hint such as summary, full, or none; host remains the policy owner.
